patterns: Mostly launch-year and ministry items: ICDS 1975 (WCD), Mid-Day Meal / NP-NSPE 1995, renamed PM POSHAN 2021, MAA by Health ministry.
'Which is NOT covered under ICDS' (family planning, free books) and 'which is NOT a nutrition programme' are recurring negative shapes.
APPSC: biggest cause of malnutrition = poor dietary habits and food insecurity; anaemia as leading cause of maternal mortality in AP; wrong-pair NIDDCP 1999.
Indicator definitions (stunting = height-for-age, wasting = weight-for-height) and Poshan Maah = September are classic.
App adds heavy AP scheme-package detail (egg/milk quantities, AWC counts) and NFHS-6 figures beyond PYQ depth.
